import docx
d=docx.Document('output/offer_letter_filled.docx')
def paras(doc):
    for p in doc.paragraphs: yield p
    for t in doc.tables:
        for r in t.rows:
            for c in r.cells:
                for p in c.paragraphs: yield p
txt='\n'.join(p.text for p in paras(d))
